artboards.title: Variables drawer: add plot / add series / arrays

annotations.text:
Authoring tool redesign, draft 2 (2026-09-15).
Brief: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-15-authoring-tool-redesign-brief.md, section 4 lists these boards.
Tokens: DESIGN.md at the repo root, lifted from the report's stylesheet.
Data is the ModelicaTestingLib demo; every button label follows brief 3.3 (object, effect, count, tooltip).

Owner rulings (2026-09-15): Material chrome. Themes swap neutrals and accent, never status or series colours. Queue rows numbered. Plots are modular: any number, any series, tracked or plot only. Option C for picking variables: a collapsible Variables drawer (one drawer at a time with Tests), filter is substring or glob with * ? and literal [ ], regex and case toggles off by default; checkbox = on the selected plot, hover for new plot. Arrays fold by index with a start:step:stop field and draw as one hue ramped by index; a profile plot kind comes later.
